description: Defines classes and methods related to account move lines and bank statement reconciliation in an OpenERP/Odoo module.

classes.name: account_move_line
classes.description: Represents account move line entries with custom query logic based on periods and creation dates.

classes.name: account_bank_statement_reconcile
classes.description: Extends bank statement reconciliation with a many-to-many relation to account move lines.

methods.name: _query_get
methods.description: Constructs a SQL query for retrieving account move lines, filtered by periods and creation dates based on context.
